changeSet.author: Core
changeSet.sql:
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'workflow' AND TABLE_NAME = 'VersionStep') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [workflow].[VersionStep]( [ID] [int] IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL, [ParentID] [int] NULL, [VersionID] [int] NOT NULL, [Name] [nvarchar](500) NOT NULL, [StepType] [int] NOT NULL, [ActivityType] [int] NOT NULL, [Settings] [xml] NULL, [Fields] [xml] NULL, [XPosition] [int] NOT NULL, [YPosition] [int] NOT NULL, [State] [int] CONSTRAINT [DF_WorkflowVersionStep_State] DEFAULT (-1) NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_WorkflowVersionStep] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( [ID] ASC ) ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.foreign_keys where name = 'FK_WorkflowVersionStep_Parent') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [workflow].[VersionStep] WITH CHECK ADD CONSTRAINT [FK_WorkflowVersionStep_Parent] FOREIGN KEY([ParentID]) REFERENCES [workflow].[VersionStep] ([ID]) ALTER TABLE [workflow].[VersionStep] CHECK CONSTRAINT [FK_WorkflowVersionStep_Parent] END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.foreign_keys where name = 'FK_WorkflowVersionStep_WorkflowVersion') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [workflow].[VersionStep] WITH CHECK ADD CONSTRAINT [FK_WorkflowVersionStep_WorkflowVersion] FOREIGN KEY([VersionID]) REFERENCES [workflow].[Version] ([ID]) ON DELETE CASCADE ALTER TABLE [workflow].[VersionStep] CHECK CONSTRAINT [FK_WorkflowVersionStep_WorkflowVersion] END
